note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor-patient conversation).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format (or plain text if JSON is not available).

Notes:
- I will produce the SOAP note exactly with the required headings (Subjective, Objective, Assessment & Plan) and the specified sub-items.
- I will extract only clinically relevant information from the transcript and DDx.
- I will record any medication mentions with missing dose/route/frequency as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both items and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will include a Quality checks section at the bottom (e.g., missing elements, conflicts).

Provide the content as:
Transcript:
<paste transcript here>

DDx:
<paste DDx JSON or text here>
